title: SpeakingItemsResponse
description: Answer of the core service's GET /v1/speaking-items: the practice sentences, in a fixed order. `text` is the exact string to send to POST /v1/score as referenceText.

id.description: Stable key of the item: the pinned Source version, the line and the offset. Not for display and not a URL path segment.

text.description: The sentence, unchanged from its source passage.

unit.description: The unit the sentence belongs to, in English (the client has no copy for it yet).
